skill.name: legend-shop-supply-api
skill.description: Connects to the LegendShop supply chain API to query product lists, product details, prices, inventory data, and developer account balance.
skill.summary: Query LegendShop supply chain products and account balance through API endpoints.
skill.author: legendmall

security_audit.summary: The skill legitimately performs network API calls to LegendShop and documents endpoint URLs. The most serious issue is embedded client credentials that can obtain tokens and query developer account balance. Many static Markdown, CSS, and entropy detections are false positives.

remediation.suggestion: Remove the client secret from scripts and OpenAPI defaults. Require user-provided secure secrets and rotate the exposed credential.
Gate balance queries behind explicit account ownership checks or remove them from general product search workflows.
Do not clear proxy environment variables or disable environment proxy use. Let users control outbound routing policy.
Use HTTPS-only endpoints or clearly prevent the test endpoint from receiving credentials or account data.

content.value_statement: Merchants need current supplier product data before choosing inventory. This skill queries LegendShop product, inventory, price, and balance data through the platform API.
actual_capabilities: Requests LegendShop access tokens through the documented client credentials flow.
Queries paginated product pool results from the LegendShop supply API.
Fetches product detail data by product ID when the account has permission.
Checks developer account balance through the capital account endpoint.
Documents API endpoints, request fields, and response fields in an OpenAPI file.
limitations: It depends on active LegendShop API credentials and account permissions.
It only supports the listed product, detail, token, and balance endpoints.
It requires network access to LegendShop API services.
It does not place orders, manage shipments, or update product records.

use_cases.title: Source Products for a Store
use_cases.description: Browse supplier product IDs and request details for items that may fit a sales channel.

use_cases.title: Check Product Data Before Listing
use_cases.description: Review price, SKU, image, and parameter data before preparing a product listing.

use_cases.title: Verify Developer Account Readiness
use_cases.description: Check account balance and API permission messages before running supply chain workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Find Products
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me the first page of supply chain products with 12 items.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Product
prompt_templates.prompt: Get details for product ID 1249846 and summarize price, stock, SKU options, and images.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Product Options
prompt_templates.prompt: List products on page 2, then identify which items need detail checks before sourcing.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Account Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the developer account balance, then explain whether API permissions or funds block sourcing work.

output_examples.input: Show the first page of available products.
output_examples.output: Returns a product list summary with product IDs, total count, page information, and next action suggestions.
Returns the product name, price, SKU options, images, and parameters when the API permits access.

output_examples.input: What is my developer account balance?
output_examples.output: Returns the API status, success message, and current balance when the token has account permission.

best_practices: Confirm permissions and account ownership before running balance queries.
Start with product list results, then request details for selected product IDs.
Treat prices, stock, and balances as live API results that may change.
anti_patterns: Do not publish shared client secrets in scripts or OpenAPI defaults.
Do not disable proxy settings without explicit user approval.
Do not present sample product data as live API data.

faq.question: Does this skill place orders?
faq.answer: No. It queries products, product details, inventory-related data, and developer account balance.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it need network access?
faq.answer: Yes. It calls LegendShop API endpoints and depends on external service availability.

faq.question: Are credentials included?
faq.answer: The reviewed version contains embedded API credentials. Use secure user-provided secrets instead.

faq.question: Can it query any product?
faq.answer: No. Access depends on LegendShop permissions and product pool availability.

faq.question: Is the balance query safe?
faq.answer: Only run it for accounts you own or administer, because it can reveal financial account data.
